steps.en: Install once through a single path — do not stack methods
steps.zh: 只走单一路径装一次，别叠装

steps.en: Planner agent produces the implementation blueprint
steps.zh: planner agent 产出实现蓝图

steps.en: Implement tests-first with the TDD workflow skill
steps.zh: 用 TDD 工作流 skill 测试先行

steps.en: tdd-guide enforces write-tests-first; bugs start as a failing repro test
steps.zh: tdd-guide 强制测试先行；修 bug 先用失败测试复现

steps.en: Ask for a review when the change is done
code-reviewer checks the work from fresh context
steps.zh: code-reviewer 在新上下文里审查改动

steps.en: Session hooks distill summaries and extract confidence-scored instincts
steps.zh: 会话 hook 蒸馏摘要并抽取带置信度的 instinct

steps.en: Next session start re-injects those instincts into context
steps.zh: 下次会话开场把它们重新注入上下文

value.en: The engineering process ships installed, not re-prompted — the agent plans, tests, reviews and remembers on its own
value.zh: 工程流程是装进去的，不是每次重新 prompt 出来的——agent 自己会规划、测试、审查、记忆

sources: README Install with Claude Code (retrieved 2026-09-27): /plugin install ecc@ecc; npx ecc-universal@2.2.2 setup guided path; 'Do not stack install methods' warning

README Start Using ECC + Common workflows (retrieved 2026-09-27): /ecc:plan "Add user authentication with OAuth" -> planner creates implementation blueprint; tdd-workflow skill -> tdd-guide enforces write-tests-first; /code-review -> code-reviewer checks your work

README intro + Continuous Learning (retrieved 2026-09-27): plan -> test -> implement -> review -> verify -> remember -> improve; sessions distilled into summaries and instincts; SessionStart ranks and injects learned instincts
